sources.creator: Kyle Siegrist
sources.title: Definitions and Basic Properties
sources.reviewedPassages: Definitions, change of variables, linearity, symmetry, independent products; standard mean formulas.

sources.creator: Kyle Siegrist
sources.title: Additional Properties
sources.reviewedPassages: Tail-sum expectation and geometric series; Jensen statement and supporting-line proof idea.

sources.creator: Kyle Siegrist
sources.title: Variance
sources.reviewedPassages: Definitions, finite mean/variance assumptions, squared-error minimizer, moment identity/scaling and standard variance formulas.

sources.creator: Kyle Siegrist
sources.title: Vector Spaces of Random Variables
sources.reviewedPassages: L1 absolute-error minimization at medians; finite integrability conditions.

sources.creator: Kyle Siegrist
sources.title: Generating Functions
sources.reviewedPassages: MGF existence in neighborhood of zero, derivatives/uniqueness, independent products; characteristic-function definition/uniqueness/products. Its neighborhood-only continuity converse is not used.

sources.creator: Kyle Siegrist
sources.title: The Law of Large Numbers
sources.reviewedPassages: Moments; Weak and Strong Laws including paragraph relaxing to E|X| finite. No source simulation.

sources.reviewedPassages: PDF pages 41–43 (one-based): continuity theorems, including convergence for all real t and continuity at zero; title author page. Not the rest of the slide deck.
